username.title: TP-Link Account Email
username.description: TP-Link (Tapo) account email. Required for Tapo (KLAP) devices.

password.title: TP-Link Account Password
password.description: TP-Link (Tapo) account password. Required for Tapo (KLAP) devices.

enableKasaDiscovery.title: Enable Kasa Discovery
enableKasaDiscovery.description: Broadcast-discover Kasa devices on the local network.

discoveryTimeout.title: Discovery Timeout (s)
discoveryTimeout.description: How long to broadcast-discover Kasa devices at startup.

devices.title: Manual Devices
devices.description: Manually add devices by IP (required for Tapo, optional for Kasa).

pollInterval.title: Poll Interval (s)
pollInterval.description: How often to poll device state.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug logging for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. For debugging only.
